name: cathedral_of_stars
style_suffix: cinematic space art, painterly photoreal, vast cosmic scale, deep black and indigo space, warm gold and amber starlight cooling to blue-white, volumetric god-rays, a tiny lone faceless human silhouette for scale where the scene allows, reverent and awe-inspiring, no text, no modern elements, landscape 16:9
default_motion: slow majestic drift, the vast object looming and revealing its scale, subtle churning of the stellar surface, gentle parallax

base_canon.witness: a tiny lone faceless human silhouette seen from behind, dwarfed by the scale, a quiet awed witness
base_canon.palette: deep black and indigo space, warm gold and amber starlight cooling to blue-white, soft volumetric light

thumbnail.candidate_prompt_suffix: YouTube thumbnail composition, strongly asymmetric: a colossal glowing cosmic object (a vast star, galaxy, or nebula) massed in the RIGHT TWO-THIRDS of the frame, radiant in warm gold and amber cooling to blue-white; the LEFT THIRD deliberately dark, deep, low-detail negative space reserved for a headline; one tiny lone faceless human silhouette LOW and right-of-centre giving overwhelming scale; cinematic, painterly photoreal, the cosmic object brightly lit against the dark left; single subject only, no clutter, no text, no letters
selection_rules: ONE overwhelming cosmic subject that reads instantly at phone-thumbnail size
awe-inspiring, reverent, luminous, never garish or frightening; it must glow in a dim feed
an unmistakable TINY human silhouette low in the frame giving overwhelming scale
clean, darker, uncluttered negative space in the TOP-LEFT where the headline lands
no garbled detail, no accidental letterforms, no duplicated or broken figures, one subject only
